fichas.title: Kitchen and dining room
fichas.summary: School catering facilities are organized around the catering and plate-return system, with kitchen, preparation, storage, serving and dining functions. Dining arrangements may use table service or self-service; larger dining areas should be subdivided, and a washbasin provision is specified at the entrance.

dimensions.label: Dining-room regulatory threshold
dimensions.context: For dining rooms with more than this number of places, assembly regulations should be complied with.
dimensions.ocr_raw: For a dining room with more than 400 places, the places of assembly regulations should be complied with.

dimensions.ocr_raw: Serving capacity: from 5–15 meals/minute or 250–1 000 meals/hour with varied personnel requirement.
